papers.title_en: Walk This Way: Crocs and the Impact of Heel Strap Utilization on Overground Walking Performance and Lower Limb Joint Kinematics.
papers.title_zh: 洞洞鞋（Crocs）后跟带使用对地面行走表现及下肢关节运动学的影响研究
papers.journal_tier: 工程：生物医学4区/运动科学4区
papers.tldr_en: The ankle kinematics suggest that when worn without a heel strap, Crocs negatively impact ankle mechanics and impact lower limb kinematics, and sports mode significantly improved walking velocity and stride length compared with comfort mode and control conditions while walking.
papers.abstract_en: Gait kinematics undergo significant alterations stemming from shoe type that can enhance performance or result in musculoskeletal injuries that impact daily living. Crocs surge to mainstream consumers, along with their presence throughout other industries, begs the question of the impact of this shoe on walking performance and kinematics. This study examined the impact of Crocs with and without heel strap on walking performance and lower body kinematics. Thirty-one participants completed 3 walking trials at self-selected pace for each condition: control (CON): socked; sports mode: Crocs with heel strap; and comfort mode: Crocs without heel strap. Inertial measurement units were used to calculate sagittal kinematics of the hip, knee, and ankle. papers.abstract_zh: 鞋类会对步态运动学产生显著影响，既可能提升运动表现，也可能导致影响日常生活的肌肉骨骼损伤。洞洞鞋（Crocs）在大众消费者和各行业中日益普及，这促使人们对其在行走表现和运动学方面的影响产生疑问。本研究旨在探讨有无后跟带的洞洞鞋（Crocs）对行走表现和下肢运动学的影响。三十一名受试者在每种条件下（对照组：穿袜；运动模式：穿戴后跟带的洞洞鞋）以自选步速完成了3次行走试验。

papers.title_en: Comparison of resistance training using barbell half squats and trap bar deadlifts on maximal strength, power performance, and lean mass in recreationally active females: an eight-week randomised trial
papers.title_zh: 杠铃半蹲与六角杠硬拉抗阻训练对休闲活跃女性最大力量、爆发力表现和去脂体重的影响比较：一项为期八周的随机试验
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: The findings suggests that in recreationally active females, exercise selection is less of a concern provided that heavy loads are applied, and relevant muscle groups are targeted.
papers.abstract_en: Background The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of high load resistance training using barbell half squats compared with trap bar deadlifts on maximal strength, power performance, and lean mass in recreationally active females. Methods Twenty-two recreationally active female participants (age: 26.9 ± 7.7 yrs.; height: 166.0 ± 5.1 cm; weight: 68.6 ± 9.9 kg) were randomly assigned to either a barbell half squat group (SG: n  = 10) or trap bar deadlift group (DG: n  = 12). Training consisted of twice-weekly sessions for eight weeks. Both groups completed one-repetition maximum (1RM) testing for both barbell half squat and trap bar deadlift groups. Countermovement jump (CMJ) and sprint performance were also assessed. Total body (TBLM) and leg lean mass (LLM) were measured with dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在探讨杠铃半蹲与六角杠硬拉两种高负荷抗阻训练对休闲活跃女性最大力量、爆发力表现和去脂体重的影响。方法：22名休闲活跃女性参与者（年龄：26.9 ± 7.7岁；身高：166.0 ± 5.1厘米；体重：68.6 ± 9.9公斤）被随机分配到杠铃半蹲组（SG: n = 10）或六角杠硬拉组（DG: n = 12）。训练每周进行两次，持续八周。两组均完成了单次最大重复次数（1RM）...

papers.title_en: A Synchronized Multi-IMU Wearable System for Tracking of Joint-Angles in Sports Motion Analysis With Reference-Based Validation and Dynamic Task Characterization
papers.title_zh: 用于运动动作分析中关节角度跟踪的同步多IMU可穿戴系统：基于参考的验证与动态任务表征
papers.abstract_en: Reliable joint-angle measurement outside laboratory environments is important for posture assessment and technique analysis in sports and rehabilitation. Yet, wearable IMU systems, despite being the most practical solution, remain constrained by drift, multisensor timing consistency, validation, and cost. This paper presents a synchronized, cost-efficient, modular IMU wearable platform and an end-to-end pipeline for joint-angle estimation tailored to high-dynamic sports motion analysis. The system combines high-rate sensing with robust local logging, a Real Time Clock-disciplined microsecond timestamping scheme for inter-node synchronization, an indirect Kalman filter-based orientation estimator followed by relative-rotation joint-angle extraction, high-pass drift mitigation, and range normalization. papers.abstract_zh: 在实验室环境之外进行可靠的关节角度测量对于体育运动和康复中的姿态评估和技术分析至关重要。然而，可穿戴IMU系统尽管是最实用的解决方案，但仍受到漂移、多传感器时间一致性、验证和成本等因素的限制。本文提出了一种同步、高成本效益、模块化的IMU可穿戴平台以及一个针对高动态体育运动分析的端到端关节角度估算流程。该系统结合了高速传感、强大的本地记录功能以及一个由实时时钟校准的微秒级...

papers.title_en: MoCap-Impute: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Comparative Analysis of Imputation Methods for IMU-based Motion Capture Data
papers.title_zh: MoCap-Impute：基于IMU运动捕捉数据插补方法的综合基准测试与比较分析
papers.tldr_en: This work proposes a systematic comparative analysis of imputation techniques, including statistical, machine learning, and deep learning techniques, for time series data of IMU-derived MoCap data, and introduces the first publicly available MoCap dataset specifically for the purpose of benchmarking missing value imputation.
papers.abstract_en: Motion capture (MoCap) data derived from wearable Inertial Measurement Units is essential to applications in sports science and healthcare robotics. However, a significant amount of the potential of this data is limited due to missing data derived from sensor limitations, network issues, and environmental interference. Such limitations can introduce bias, prevent the fusion of critical data streams, and ultimately compromise the integrity of human activity analysis. Despite the plethora of data imputation techniques available, there have been few systematic performance evaluations of these techniques explicitly for the time series data of IMU-derived MoCap data. We address this by evaluating the imputation performance across three distinct contexts: univariate time series, multivariate across players, and multivariate across kinematic angles. To address this limitation, we propose a syst
papers.abstract_zh: 源自可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）的运动捕捉（MoCap）数据对于体育科学和医疗机器人领域的应用至关重要。然而，由于传感器限制、网络问题和环境干扰导致的缺失数据，这些数据的潜力在很大程度上受到了限制。此类限制可能引入偏差，阻碍关键数据流的融合，并最终损害人类活动分析的完整性。尽管目前存在大量数据插补技术，但对这些技术进行系统性性能评估的研究却相对较少。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：一项关于离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：离心抗阻训练被公认为是一种有效刺激，能够增强成人群体的肌肉力量和爆发力指标；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚未被充分理解。目的：本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心抗阻训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法：从电子搜索引擎检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章...

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：损伤预防与康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。尽管传统的实验室评估提供了深入见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在（1）评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，（2）探讨其在康复监测和临床决策制定中的作用，以及（3）识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。
